title: HCP Terraform concepts
subtitle: Explore team workflows and policies without setting up an HCP account.

delta.before: Terraform Cloud named the hosted platform and its workspaces.
delta.after: Try projects, workspace workflows and policies in the local sandbox.

exercises.title: Governance & Hierarchy Sandbox
exercises.description: Try projects, shared variables, run triggers and policies locally. You will not need an HCP account.

cases.prompt: Share environment settings with workspaces in one project.
choices: Put all workspaces in one state file
Copy a local .aws directory into each plan
cases.explanation: Variable sets share scoped values; each workspace still keeps its own state.

cases.prompt: A pull request should show proposed infrastructure effects without applying.
cases.explanation: A speculative plan previews a proposal and cannot be applied as a normal approved run.

cases.prompt: A successful apply should queue a dependent workspace run.
cases.explanation: Run triggers connect workspace workflows; they do not merge their state.

cost.assumptions: Short-lived resources, no compute, standard parameters, no uploads; gross usage before account credits.

checkpoints.prompt: What is the relationship between a project and a workspace?

choices.b: A project is one shared state file

rationale.b: Projects are an organizational grouping, not a single state boundary.

checkpoints.prompt: Which pair contains OPA enforcement levels?

rationale.a: OPA uses this pair; authorized override behavior depends on permissions/settings.
rationale.b: Those labels belong to Sentinel rather than OPA.

checkpoints.prompt: A local CLI starts a remote HCP run. Where are provider operations executed?

rationale.a: CLI-driven describes the trigger; remote describes execution.
rationale.b: A local trigger does not imply local execution.
